verdict.rationale: Gitea's own docs say review submitters can respond to comments and modify code online, and that reviewers browse code and leave feedback in the web UI. That directly addresses responding to review feedback by editing in the browser. Only a single brief claim supports it, with no detail on how browser edits are committed to the PR branch. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of in-browser editing and committing (commit messages, target branch, updating the PR), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can respond to review feedback by editing and committing code directly in the browser

citations.quote: Submitters can receive review comments and respond or modify code online.
Reviewers can browse code online and provide review comments or feedback.
